note: Seed evaluation set. `document_id` should be filled in with a real uploaded document's id before running (leave null to search across all documents). `relevant_pages` enables exact retrieval precision/recall; omit it if unknown and only answer-quality (judge) metrics will be computed for that case.

cases.question: What is this document about?
cases.expected_answer: A high-level description of the document's main subject.

cases.question: What methodology or approach does the document describe?
What are the key findings or conclusions?
What limitations does the document mention?
What data or dataset was used, if any?
Who are the authors or what organization produced this document?
What future work or next steps are suggested?
Are there any numerical results or metrics reported?
What problem is the document trying to solve?
What is the capital of France?
cases.expected_answer: I couldn't find this information in the uploaded document.
cases.note: Adversarial/out-of-scope case: verifies the system correctly refuses to answer from outside knowledge.

cases.question: What were its limitations?
cases.note: Standalone version of a common follow-up; pairs conceptually with q4 to sanity-check query rewriting when run inside a conversation (not exercised by the standalone eval runner).
